about_the_game:
Race through the conspiracy-rife city of Ausaka as you both share sensations with and support your partner.

Play as a hacker backing up Misha—whose brain has been transplanted into a sexyroid—as you face off against all threats that stand in your way. See things through Misha's eyes during shooting scenes and support Misha indirectly by hacking into surveillance cameras.

Battles, searches, rescue missions, and guarding assignments await you in the grungy, conspiracy-rife Ausaka City. Some assignments will have you going undercover to carry out your mission. Infiltrate raves and slip past enemy patrols to obtain codes and steal secrets hidden behind electronic locks.

Use the money you earn to acquire new weapons and hacking skills to get your hands on top-secret corporate data. But be careful not to spend too much—you'll need to collect 10 billion yen by the deadline, or else your partner will be stuck in this body forever.

Will your partner remain a man, or will he awaken to a new sexuality? It's up to you, the player, to decide.

Misha has long been your irreplaceable partner-in-arms, someone you’ve trusted with your life. But now that he's a she, your friendship will be put to the test. Misha attempts to remain a man to protect both his dignity and your friendship, but the effects the sexyroid's body has on the mind are merciless. Once you finally earn enough money to return Misha's body to normal, will there even be a reason to go back?

Though a regular man on the inside, Misha's appearance is now nothing short of a stunning woman. Perhaps it's inevitable that a player tempted by desire might act on that urge... When all is said and done, will you stand together as comrades or as lovers?
